meaning: Logical independence only. Each finite witness contains an actual source-to-effect power transmission and an effect without intrinsic power, not merely a free-standing inductive derivation. Still, an intrinsic source in a designated power channel need not be an uncaused or incomposite being. Two coherent finite countermodels isolate BR-POWER-TO-BEING and BR-SIMPLICITY from #319; the models do not represent unexercised capacities, refute Aquinas' richer source readings, or establish which scenario is metaphysically possible.
